summary: This document specifies a method to split control plane and user plane in a Proxy Mobile IPv6 network. Existing options let a mobile access gateway separate them, but no way existed to signal such a split to the local mobility anchor.

eli5.summary: In a mobile network, one box can handle both instructions and data. This RFC lets them be handled by different machines.

questions: pmipv6 control plane user plane separation
split cp up proxy mobile ipv6
